observations.title: Aira volcano (Japan)
observations.description: The Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) reported ongoing eruptive activity at Minamidake Crater (Aira Caldera?s Sakurajima volcano) during 14-21 September. Crater incandescence was visible in nighttime webcam images during 14-18 September. Volcanologists conducted a field survey on 15 September and measured high sulfur dioxide emissions, averaging 2,600 tons per day. A total of 32 eruptive events during the week produced ash plumes that rose as high as 2.5 km above the crater and ejected large blocks 600 m from the vent. The Alert Level remained at 3 (on a 5-level scale), and the public was warned to be cautious within 1 km of both the Minimadake and Showa craters. Source: Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA)
